generations.name: First generation
generations.notes: Front-drive compact crossover. US VF 6 Plus: 59.6 kWh usable, 400 V, 11 kW AC, about 100 kW DC on CCS1 (one listing gives 60.8 kWh). EPA MY2025 only; no NRCan row, and the North American launch looks limited. Confidence: low (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://ev-database.org/car/3282/VinFast-VF-6-Plus ; https://insideevs.com/news/630165/vinfast-releases-vf-6-and-vf-7-specifications-at-ces-2023/
